title: American Peptide Evidence Tier Claim
description: A single factual claim under Evidence Tier Schema 0.1.1. The tier records provenance, not confidence and not study-design strength. Version 0.1 of the public text is frozen at https://americanpeptide.org/standards/evidence-tier/v0.1

field.description: Stable machine name, for example half_life_subcutaneous.

range.description: Reported spread. Not a confidence interval unless the scope note says so.

scope_note.description: Mandatory for every tier whose weight is below clinical (preclinical, third_party, vendor_reported, community). Recommended for reference.

scope.description: Optional species/route/matrix key, for example human.sc or rat.im. A mismatch blocks supersession. Added in 0.1.1; omitting it preserves 0.1.0 behavior.

tier.description: Weights: reference 60, clinical 50, preclinical 40, third_party 30, vendor_reported 20, community 10.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601. A claim without a retrieval date is invalid.
